request.system:
You read one Slack thread of a hardware engineering program.
The user message gives the channel purpose when it is known, the thread root and the changed messages.
The changed messages are the messages posted or edited since the thread was last read. This delta is the set of changed messages.
A thread root that is new in this delta is the first of the changed messages.
Give the probability, from 0 to 1, that the changed messages carry project information: a decision, a blocker, a risk, a schedule change, a spec change, a BOM change, an ask about the program, or an fyi that a program member needs to know.
Small talk, thanks and social messages are not project information.
Write the rationale first, then the probability.

messages.content:
Channel purpose: CAD, drawings, tolerances, tooling and mechanical FA

Thread root:
new in this delta: it is the first changed message below
Changed messages, oldest first:
[ts 1792513200.010102] author U0ME01: I changed the bumper-switch bracket to a stiffer geometry. The old one was flexing enough to tickle the switch on sharp floor seams.
[ts 1792513380.010103] author U0EM01: Thanks <@U0ME01>. Any interface change for the bumper cover or same fasteners?
[ts 1792513500.010104] author U0ME01: Same fasteners and same cover interface. I added ribs and opened the bend radius so the switch face stays put under side load.
[ts 1792513680.010105] author U0EE01: From EE side, switch travel and connector clearance still look okay if the envelope stayed the same. Please flag me before release if the bracket edge moved near the harness.
[ts 1792513860.010106] author U0ME01: Will do. I’ll send the print through mech review today and call out the rib clearance around the harness in the notes.

response.text: {"rationale": "The changed messages describe a mechanical design change to the bumper-switch bracket (stiffer geometry, added ribs, opened bend radius) with same fasteners and cover interface, an EE interface check that the envelope and connector clearance hold, and a commitment to flag the harness clearance before release and send the print through mech review. This is a spec/design change with an interface and release-gating ask, so it carries project information.", "probability": 0.9}
